hypotheses.justification: Through the `ι`/`F̄` notations the statement mentions `M` in `CohCarrier.GammaH M ⊥`, so the instance-implicit variable `[NeZero M]` becomes an argument; `omit X in` does not remove it. Nothing in the statement needs it. `CohCarrier.GammaH` is defined in Definitions/Def_CohCarrier_Level.lean under `variable (M : ℕ)` with no `NeZero`, as `(H.comap (gamma0Units M)).map (Gamma0 M).subtype`. `gamma0Units`, `Gamma0` and `⊥ : Subgroup (ZMod M)ˣ` also elaborate for any `M`. `qExpFunctionFieldC K Γ` (Definitions/Def_ModularCurve_X1.lean) is defined for any `Γ : Subgroup SL(2, ℤ)` and only needs `[Field K]`. The proof is `rfl`: the coercion of `algebraMap K F̄ r` into `LaurentSeries K` is definitionally `algebraMap K (LaurentSeries K) r` for any intermediate field, so the case `M = 0` is no different. The statement therefore elaborates and the same `rfl` proof works with `omit [NeZero M] in`.
